product_name: Injection-Molded Enclosure for Industrial IoT Gateway
description: Weatherproof (IP65) polycarbonate/ABS blend enclosure, 180mm x 120mm x 60mm, for an outdoor-rated industrial IoT gateway. Requires UV-stable resin, EMI shielding insert compatibility, and tight dimensional tolerance (+/- 0.15mm) for a snap-fit lid.
sourcing_event: SourceFix Hackathon Track 1 - AI Manufacturing Decision Copilot

requirements.label: Quality Management Certification
requirements.requirement: Must hold a currently valid ISO9001 or IATF16949 certificate (not expired, not suspended).
requirements.rationale: Non-negotiable quality-system gate required by the end customer's automotive-adjacent supply chain policy.

requirements.label: Minimum Monthly Production Capacity
requirements.requirement: Must be able to sustain at least 20,000 units/month.
requirements.rationale: Below this threshold the supplier cannot cover ramp-up volume without a second source; treated as a capability gate, not a negotiating point.

requirements.label: Minimum Quality History Score
requirements.requirement: Must have a quality history score of at least 85 (out of 100, based on defect rate / audit history / on-time delivery of prior lots).
requirements.rationale: Track record below this score has historically correlated with field failures for enclosure parts; not commercially negotiable.

requirements.label: Maximum Minimum Order Quantity
requirements.requirement: MOQ should be no more than 5,000 units.
requirements.rationale: Preferred ceiling for initial pilot batches; suppliers above this can often be negotiated down or split across a phased PO.

requirements.label: Maximum Lead Time
requirements.requirement: Lead time should be no more than 45 days.
requirements.rationale: Desired for launch schedule but expeditable freight or partial shipments can often close a small gap.

requirements.label: Acceptable Manufacturing Regions
requirements.requirement: Must manufacture in one of: North America, Western Europe, Southeast Asia.
requirements.rationale: Preferred for tariff exposure and logistics; a strong supplier outside these regions could still be considered with a landed-cost review.

requirements.label: Minimum Sustainability Score
requirements.requirement: Sustainability score should be at least 60 (out of 100, based on emissions reporting, energy sourcing, waste handling).
requirements.rationale: Aligns with buyer ESG goals; can be waived for an otherwise strong supplier pending a corrective action plan.

notes: This brief was authored for the SourceFix hackathon prototype. No client-supplied dataset exists for this theme, so both this brief and the accompanying supplier list are synthetic test fixtures (see source_manifest.md).
